samples.title: Thói quen đi bộ
samples.prompt: Your friend is interested in walking as a daily habit but does not know where to begin. Write an email giving practical advice, explaining a possible difficulty, and offering help.

samples.summaryVi: Đi bộ dễ thành thói quen khi đường tới nơi cần đến thuận tiện và không bị cản trở.

paragraphs.label: Mở thư
paragraphs.text:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for telling me about your interest in walking as a daily habit. I understand why you are unsure where to start. You do not need a perfect plan immediately, but a few practical steps could make things easier.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đồng cảm, xác định mục đích khuyên.

paragraphs.label: Lời khuyên đầu
paragraphs.text: First, I suggest joining a neighbourhood walking event at the park entrance on Saturday at nine in the morning. There, we can explore a short local route and note useful improvements. One useful point is that people can include gentle movement in ordinary routines. For example, a resident can walk to a nearby market instead of taking a motorbike for a very short trip.
paragraphs.noteVi: Gợi ý hoạt động có ngày, nơi và lý do.

paragraphs.label: Khó khăn và cách xử lý
paragraphs.text: One thing to remember is that some routes are difficult to use. This can happen because street design may give little attention to people travelling on foot. A useful response would be to keep pavements clear and improve practical walking routes. For instance, a local group could identify one important route to the market and report the barriers along it. Try the idea on a small scale before deciding whether to continue.

paragraphs.label: Đề nghị và kết
paragraphs.text:
If you like, I can come with you and help you write down the most useful points. Afterwards, we could make a simple plan together.

Please let me know what you think when you have a moment. I would be happy to answer any other questions.

Best wishes,
Minh
